cloud.access_key_old: long-lived access key / service-account key not rotated in 90 days
replace long-lived keys with federation/roles; otherwise rotate every 90 days
cloud.admin_privileges_broad: identity has administrative privileges it should not need
grant least privilege; no admin roles on workload identities
cloud.audit_log_disabled: control-plane audit logging is not enabled everywhere
enable a multi-region/organisation audit trail (CloudTrail, Cloud Audit Logs, Activity Log export)
cloud.firewall_admin_port_open: firewall rule allows SSH/RDP (admin ports) from the internet
restrict the rule's source to known addresses or use a bastion/SSM/IAP instead of opening admin ports
cloud.firewall_open_to_internet: firewall rule allows all ports from the internet
allow only the ports the service needs, from the sources that need them
cloud.instance_metadata_v1: instance metadata service allows unauthenticated v1 requests
cloud.instance_unpatched: instance is missing patches or is not under patch management
bring the instance under the provider's patch management and apply missing updates
cloud.password_policy_weak: account password policy is weaker than the benchmark
set a password policy (length >= 14, reuse prevention) or move humans to SSO
cloud.platform_credential_over_privilege: the security platform's own cloud credential can write (expected read-only)
detach every policy/role except the read-only audit ones (docs/cloud.md: permissions)
cloud.public_endpoint: remove the public address or put the resource behind a load balancer / private endpoint
cloud.root_mfa_disabled: root / break-glass account has no MFA
enable hardware or passkey MFA on the root account
cloud.root_used: use named, least-privilege identities; keep root for break-glass
cloud.service_account_key_user_managed: use workload identity federation / attached service accounts instead of keys
cloud.snapshot_public: snapshot or machine image is shared publicly
remove public sharing; block public sharing at account level
cloud.storage_insecure_transport: deny requests without TLS (aws:SecureTransport / secure transfer required)
cloud.storage_public: block public access at account and bucket level; share through signed URLs or a CDN with origin access
cloud.storage_unencrypted: storage has no default encryption configured
enable default encryption (provider-managed or customer-managed keys)
cloud.user_without_mfa: user with console/password access has no MFA
enable MFA (phishing-resistant where possible) for every human user; enforce it by policy
cloud.volume_unencrypted: block volume or snapshot is not encrypted
enable encryption by default for new volumes; migrate data to encrypted volumes

aws.sql:
select arn, region, account_id, 'bucket policy or ACL grants access to everyone' as detail
from aws_s3_bucket
where not (coalesce(block_public_policy, false) and coalesce(restrict_public_buckets, false))
  and (exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(policy_std -> 'Statement', '[]'::jsonb)) s
               where s ->> 'Effect' = 'Allow' and (s -> 'Principal' -> 'AWS') ? '*')
       or exists (select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(acl -> 'Grants', '[]'::jsonb)) g
                  where g -> 'Grantee' ->> 'URI' like '%/global/AllUsers'))

select arn, region, account_id, 'no default encryption configuration' as detail
from aws_s3_bucket where server_side_encryption_configuration is null
   or jsonb_array_length(coalesce(server_side_encryption_configuration -> 'Rules', '[]'::jsonb)) = 0

select distinct 'arn:aws:ec2:' || region || ':' || account_id || ':security-group/' || group_id as arn, region, account_id,
       'ingress ' || ip_protocol || ' ' || coalesce(from_port::text, '*') || '-' || coalesce(to_port::text, '*') || ' from '
       || coalesce(cidr_ipv4::text, cidr_ipv6::text) as detail
from aws_vpc_security_group_rule
where not is_egress and (cidr_ipv4 = '0.0.0.0/0' or cidr_ipv6 = '::/0')
  and (ip_protocol = '-1' or (ip_protocol = 'tcp' and ((from_port <= 22 and to_port >= 22) or (from_port <= 3389 and to_port >= 3389))))

select arn, 'global' as region, account_id, 'console password without MFA' as detail
from aws_iam_user where login_profile is not null and not mfa_enabled

select 'arn:aws:iam::' || account_id || ':user/' || user_name as arn, 'global' as region, account_id,
       'active access key created ' || create_date::date as detail
from aws_iam_access_key where status = 'Active' and create_date < now() - interval '90 days'

select 'arn:aws:iam::' || account_id || ':root' as arn, 'global' as region, account_id, 'root account MFA disabled' as detail
from aws_iam_account_summary where not account_mfa_enabled

select 'arn:aws:iam::' || account_id || ':root' as arn, 'global' as region, account_id, 'root access keys present' as detail
from aws_iam_account_summary where account_access_keys_present > 0

select 'arn:aws:cloudtrail:{region}:' || account_id || ':trail' as arn, '{region}' as region, account_id,
       'no logging multi-region trail' as detail
from aws_account
where not exists (select 1 from aws_cloudtrail_trail t where t.is_multi_region_trail and t.is_logging)
select arn, region, account_id, 'volume not encrypted' as detail from aws_ebs_volume where not encrypted

select arn, region, account_id, 'snapshot shared with all accounts' as detail
from aws_ebs_snapshot where create_volume_permissions @> '[{"Group": "all"}]'
